blocks.content: The && "AND" operator is used with two boolean expressions. It returns:

items: true - if both boolean expressions are true
false - if either of the boolean expressions is false

blocks.content: Suppose a bank offers a loan if the applicant's credit score is 700 or higher, and they have an annual income of $6000.
In this case, both conditions must be true for the applicant to qualify for the loan. This is where the && operator is applied.
